notes: Verified via Wayback Machine snapshot of kviconline.gov.in PMEGP e-portal. 9 pages (some with parse errors), 4.4 MB, 5 PMEGP mentions in OCR'd text. Scanned image PDF - OCR'd with tesseract eng+tel. OCR text reveals: Date 23.11.2015, Reference No. PMEGP/RC/2015-16/, Subject: 'Adopting Udyog Aadhar Memorandum for registering PMEGP units online'. This is the Tier 1 priority #2 document from the acquisition roadmap (Udyam Portal registration O.M.). Udyog Aadhar was the predecessor to the current Udyam Registration portal (which replaced UAM in July 2020). An OCR'd companion file (_ocr.pdf) is saved alongside the original.
